A1.justification: Both complete, readable PDFs describe FIRE and contain corresponding main sections, Tables 1–4, Figures 1–13, and supplementary Section 6. Text extraction and visual inspection support reliable comparison, including the appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original detection experiments, frequency-mask and loss ablations, perturbation tests, and reconstruction visualizations in Sections 4 and 6.

after.justification: v3 retains the original detection results, ablations, robustness experiments, and supplementary reconstruction visualizations.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.4 retain the same FMRE architecture, autoencoder reconstruction procedure, concatenated error-map classifier, and training losses. No algorithmic component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same DiffusionForensics subsets and self-collected LAION-based dataset covering DALL·E 3, Kandinsky 3, Midjourney, SDXL, and Segmind Vega. Perturbation scenarios and supplementary example coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain CNNDet, AEROBLADE, DIRE, and FakeInversion. Figure 7 retains the same robustness comparators: AEROBLADE, DIRE, and FakeInversion.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same splits, preprocessing, model configuration, training budget, and use of both AUC and ACC. Tables 1–2 correct the stated reporting order of these metrics without changing the evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: The predefined-mask ablation in Table 3, loss ablation in Table 4, perturbation analysis in Figure 7, and frequency/reconstruction visualizations are retained. Supplementary Figures 8–13 contain the same examples.

E5.justification: Repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, and significance tests are not added or revised. The tables and robustness plots retain the same point-result reporting.

E6.justification: Tables 1–2 retain every numerical entry but correct their metric attribution from ACC/AUC to AUC/ACC. For example, Table 2's unchanged FIRE result 78.3/72.6 for DALL·E 3 training/testing is now labeled 78.3% AUC and 72.6% ACC. This is a reporting correction; no new performance outcome is demonstrated.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(18), including the diffusion formulation, frequency-mask definitions, reconstruction errors, and losses, are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about frequency-guided reconstruction, end-to-end detection, unseen-model generalization, and perturbation robustness.

C2.justification: The mid-frequency mechanism explanation and generalization interpretations remain unchanged. Section 4.4 retains the severe-blur weakness relative to FakeInversion and the explanation involving destruction of frequency information.

D1.justification: v3 adds a code-availability statement and the Chuchad/FIRE GitHub repository link in the abstract, absent from v2. Implementation, hyperparameter, preprocessing, and hardware disclosures otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions retain the same 50 references and related-work discussion. The positioning relative to reconstruction-based detectors and frequency-domain methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: The abstract gains one code-access sentence, and the arXiv version/date line changes. The remaining prose, terminology, section sequence, and supplementary structure are retained.

P2.justification: Tables 1–2 have corrected metric-order captions, and the abstract addition causes limited text reflow on early pages. Figure content, table structures, and supplementary displays are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The corrected table captions resolve an AUC/ACC inconsistency with Section 4.2.2 and the AUC ablations in Tables 3–4. The added code link improves access information, although the PDFs do not establish the repository's contents or usability. These are useful, limited improvements to reporting and reproducibility information; the scientific method and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
